cnn.pool: global maximum over positions and both strands with shared convolution weights
cnn.head: linear binary logit; 1201 parameters total
cnn.selection: fixed final epoch, no Development/Test checkpoint selection

supervision: CNN_LABEL uses Discovery sequence-level positive/blank labels, never planted coordinates, direction or reference. CNN_SHUFFLED uses a fixed permutation of the same labels. CNN_RANDOM retains their common initial weights. OH48_BG uses positive Discovery window clustering and negative Discovery background rejection, no classifier training. Unequal label use and RC-equivariant inductive bias forbid attributing any gap to embedding alone.
extraction: CNN: one maximal post-ReLU activation window per positive sequence per filter, choose across both strands, canonicalize RC fragments to filter direction; retain strictly above that filter's Discovery blank max-activation95th percentile; require20 sequences; rebuild PWM with pseudocount0.5. OH48_BG: prior frozen full48-dimensional One-hot KMeans and one-pass background rejection, no PCA or alignment.
ranking: Discovery positive-minus-blank sequence presence at each PWM's Discovery blank maxscore95th percentile, ties information bits/support/id; no reference or Test
views: FULL and CAP5 for all4 methods; MATCH_OH48 for CNN_LABEL/OH48_BG each min(5,both available); zero budgets retained as0 F1, never counted as superiority
primary_endpoint: mut30_random MATCH_OH48 reference-assisted localizationF1, CNN_LABEL minus OH48_BG; average2 algorithm seeds within each data seed before3 data-seed summary
secondary: FULL/CAP5, random-weight/shuffled-label controls, mixed strands, strong control, all-candidate blank FPR, budgets; sequence classification AUROC/AP/accuracy separately
pilot_gate: further independent replication only if primary mean delta>0 and all3 data seeds positive; CAP5 mean CNN_LABEL F1 exceeds each control and OH48_BG; no zero matched budget; matched family FPR<=OH48_BG. Not formal significance/general/functional superiority.
test_policy: finish every model, PWM, Discovery ranking and budget membership before ANY Development/Test scoring; no Test tuning or further model variants in this version
limits: 3 independent synthetic data repeats, not6; blank streams repeat across difficulty conditions with a common seed; known12bp width; not real promoter grammar, full DeepBind reproduction or a pretrained DNA embedding model
